game.title: Green Bay Packers at Detroit Lions

lede: Detroit Lions carries the stronger EdgeDesk offensive profile (#4 in EPA per play), while Green Bay Packers owns the more favourable defensive matchup (#16 in EPA allowed per play).
EdgeDesk’s independent projection makes it Detroit Lions −5.5 with a fair total of 50.0 — inside a touchdown, before any sportsbook number is consulted.

The widest measured matchup on the board is Detroit Lions pass offence vs Green Bay Packers pass defence, which sits +0.181 from the league mean once the two ratings are combined the way the model combines them.
